irons_spellbooks: Spellbooks, scrolls, inks, the inscription table and school-based combat magic
Combat counterpart to Ars utility magic for expeditions and bosses; its own ink rarity, spell focus drops and mana stay native
irons_jewelry: Crafted rings and amulets with gem bonuses from a jeweller's bench
Curios equipment that complements Iron's spell schools and expedition kits without another loot tier
forbidden_arcanus: Dark magic materials, the clibano furnace and Hephaestus forge rituals
The eternal-stella ritual adds a containment seal (IV) before tools can become unbreakable; clibano smelting joins ore processing
theurgy: Spagyric alchemy: calcination, liquefaction, distillation, incubation and reformation
A magical ore-processing line beside Mekanism; the sulfuric flux emitter for same-tier reformation needs a containment seal (IV)
not_enough_glyphs: Additional Ars Nouveau glyphs, including multi-target and utility effects
Deepens the existing Ars spell workshop without another magic system
starbunclemania: Starbuncle upgrades that carry fluids and source and follow wider routes
Extends Ars familiar logistics beside Pipez and Modular Routers in early magic workshops
reliquary: Mob-drop relics, pedestals, handguns, potions and utility charms
Rending Gale flight needs a horizon chart (IV); alkahestry duplication and spawn-egg uncrafting are removed
artifacts: Wearable artifacts found in chests, campsites and mimics
Exploration rewards through Lootr containers and expedition loot, not crafted power

qol.ars_polymorphia: Lets Polymorph choose between conflicting Ars Nouveau apparatus and imbuement outputs

notes.source: All pins come from the read-only ATM10 8.1 reference instance at E:/curseforge/Instances/All the Mods 10 - ATM10. SHA-1 matched its CurseForge metadata; licenses, dependency ranges and sides were read from each JAR. No reference-pack configuration, script, quest or asset is included.
notes.dependencyClosure: New libraries: Iron's Lib and Player Animation Lib (Iron's Spells), Atlas API (Iron's Jewelry) and Valhelsia Core (Forbidden and Arcanus). GeckoLib, Curios, Modonomicon, Ars Nouveau and Polymorph were already pinned. Artifacts embeds Expandability.
notes.staging: tools/generate_family_balance.py --family arcane writes pack/kubejs/server_scripts/entrelumen_arcane_balance.js and the eternal-stella ritual override under pack/kubejs/data/forbidden_arcanus.
notes.companion: The Ark arcane library separates vanilla stored enchantments; no selected mod replaces vanilla enchanting, enchanted books or anvil rules.
notes.exclusions: Apotheosis with Apothic Enchanting, Attributes and Spawners; Ars Elemancy; Relics with OctoLib and Reliquified Artifacts; Theurgy KubeJS; Ars Unification. Reasons are in the family design note.
